BUILT AROUND THE WAY YOU WORK

The right stylist. The right amount of time.

A quick trim and a longer treatment should not compete for the same default slot. Configure the duration and price for your service menu, assign the people who provide it and leave preparation time where your salon needs it.

Let customers choose their person

Assign services to teammates and manage availability per stylist. The booking can follow the provider rather than a single calendar for the whole salon.

A service menu with real durations

Offer the appointment lengths your services need. Custom durations and booking rules help shape the day around the work.

A clear commitment before arrival

Use deposits or prepayment and explain the cancellation policy before customers book. Add reminders to keep the appointment details easy to find.

Rebook while they are still smiling

Use Cowlendar in Shopify POS to make a follow-up appointment and take an in-person payment. Online and counter bookings belong to the same Cowlendar schedule.

FROM PRODUCT TO BOOKABLE SERVICE

A straightforward place to start.

  1. 01

    Build the service menu

    Create bookable products with the right duration, price and preparation instructions. Assign the stylists who can deliver each service.

  2. 02

    Configure the calendar and payments

    Set stylist availability, calendar connections and the deposit or prepayment flow. Make the cancellation policy visible.

  3. 03

    Test online and at the desk

    Place a storefront booking, confirm the stylist calendar and then try a follow-up in Shopify POS. Check changes and customer notifications.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Salons & beauty questions, answered.

Can customers choose a stylist?

Yes. Set up the teammates assigned to a service and their availability, then configure teammate selection in the booking flow.

Can I take a deposit for a hair appointment?

Yes. Cowlendar supports deposits and prepayment. Confirm how the remaining balance is collected and how cancellations affect payments.

Can I book a follow-up from Shopify POS?

Yes. Cowlendar’s POS guide documents creating bookings and collecting payment from the Shopify POS app.

Can I sell salon products alongside appointments?

Yes. Your Shopify store can offer physical products and bookable services. Only the products you configure as services need a booking flow.
